name: Francisco Assis - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on the European Investment Bank, the EU's own lending bank. It asks the bank to lend more to close Europe's investment gap, keep its top credit rating, and do more for defence, affordable housing, small businesses, climate projects and Ukraine. It also wants the bank to be more open and accountable to Parliament. The report is an opinion: it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the bank to lend more and widen defence and housing support.
- **Who it affects:** The bank, EU governments, small firms, homebuilders, defence companies and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** The bank and EU governments decide whether to act on these requests.
